settings.founder_heading: Started in 2009 with one knitting machine in Gujranwala.
settings.founder_body:
We still craft knitwear with the same passion. For many years, we made knitwear for global brands. Now we're bringing the same quality to Pakistan under our own name.

We are a factory that finally decided to build a brand.
settings.year1_body: A single knitting machine in Gujranwala's Small Industrial Estate.
settings.year2_body: Knitting for global brands. Years of quiet craft, learning by hand.
settings.year3_body: The same quality, finally under our own name.
